title: Why a Base, in Humidity
caption:
Beauty Note — No. 01
Why a Base, in Humidity

In humid seasons and climates, a base has three jobs: to help foundation last, to control shine, and to keep skin from feeling sticky.

So skip creamy, rich formulas. Choose a light, fresh base that balances oil.

Apply it mainly where you tend to get shiny or sticky, using just a little, even less than a pearl.
